title: 第179章 丈夫
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

后背陡然一冷！

宋瓷抬眸，看了一眼陌生号码。

立刻动用关系去查找这个陌生号码的IP地址。

很快，对方发来回复：“抱歉宋小姐，是个虚拟IP，一点真实信息都查不到。”

这边刚得到消息，陌生号码再次发来了消息。

【陌生号码】：这样的内容，我手中还有很多。

是孟晚？

她蓄意接近祝砚铮的事，目前只有孟晚知道，宋瓷现在只能认为对方是孟晚，或是跟孟晚有关的人。

【宋瓷】：你想说什么？

她不需要露出任何漏洞和证据。

即便说破天，这也只是一张监控照片而已。

只是拍到了她从洗手间里出来，那时她的药都放在了包里，不可能被拍到。

所以这张图，没有其他佐证，做不了任何威胁她的证据。

只不过宋瓷的消息发送过去，对方就再没回复过了。

宋瓷微微蹙眉，不多时她委托的查找IP的人也再次发来消息。

“宋小姐，这个号码消失了，注销掉了。”

一点线索都被销毁了。

宋瓷眉头紧皱，脸色冷沉。

所以，孟晚还是没有放弃找她的证据。

祝砚铮对她的偏袒，又能够持续多久呢？

宋瓷眯了眯眼，眼中闪过一抹深意。

——还是要做两手准备。

第二天一早，宋瓷起床时，也已经是早上九点钟了。

洗漱完毕，换好衣服下楼时，祝砚铮已经在客厅等候了。

不知道是不是宋瓷的错觉，最近的祝砚铮，似乎对与她共同用餐有种执念。

好像不管她起床多晚，不管他们前段时间如何“冷战”，两人最终都要坐在一张餐桌上吃饭。

今天早上也是这样。

见她下楼，祝砚铮放下报纸起身：“吃早饭。”

两人坐在了餐桌前。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A sudden chill ran down my back!

Song Ci raised her eyes and glanced at the unfamiliar number.

Immediately use the relationship to find the IP address of this strange number.

Soon, the other party sent a reply: "Sorry, Miss Song, it's a virtual IP, and no real information can be found."

I just got the news here, and another message was sent from an unknown number.

[Unknown number]: I still have a lot of content like this.

Is it Meng Wan?

Only Meng Wan knew about her deliberate approach to Zhu Yanzheng. Song Ci could only think that the other party was Meng Wan or someone related to Meng Wan.

[Song Ci]: What do you want to say?

She doesn't need to reveal any loopholes or evidence.

Even if it means breaking the sky, this is just a surveillance photo.

She was only photographed coming out of the bathroom. At that time, her medicine was all in her bag, so it was impossible to be photographed.

Therefore, this picture, without other supporting evidence, cannot be used as any evidence to threaten her.

It's just that after Song Ci's message was sent, the other party never replied.

Song Ci frowned slightly, and not long after, the person she entrusted to find the IP also sent another message.

"Ms. Song, this number has disappeared and been logged out."

Every clue was destroyed.

Song Ci frowned, her expression cold.

Therefore, Meng Wan still did not give up looking for her evidence.

How long can Zhu Yanzheng's favoritism towards her last?

Song Ci squinted his eyes, a hint of deep meaning flashed in his eyes.

——You still need to be prepared.

The next morning, when Song Ci got up, it was already nine o'clock in the morning.

After washing up, changing clothes and going downstairs, Zhu Yanzheng was already waiting in the living room.

I don't know if it's Song Ci's misunderstanding, but Zhu Yanzheng seems to be obsessed with dining with her recently.

It seemed that no matter how late she got up, no matter how "cold war" they had some time ago, the two of them would eventually sit at the same dining table to eat.

Same thing this morning.

Seeing her going downstairs, Zhu Yanzheng put down the newspaper and stood up: "Have breakfast."

The two sat at the dining table.
